sigma.note: Sigma fields are pre-saturation scale. Rating error uses bound × tanh(spread × z / bound), plus unchanged tiny floor × z.

physicalDemand.formula: D = D20 × [T × (launchSpeed − endpointSpeed)] / [T20 × (launchSpeed20 − endpointSpeed)] + existing redirection + motion

solver.spinConstraint: Joint speed/backspin solve for depth and fast travel time; endpoint takes priority at physical bounds

selection.rule: locked for flight; no automatic reassignment
selection.scoreRule: endpoint distance + bounded (0–4 m) current-heading penalty; deterministic id tie-break

executionSolve.method: Physical-demand spread → bounded delivery error → contact-only pace/backspin inverse

sigma.note: Sigma fields are pre-saturation scale. Rating error uses bound × tanh(spread × z / bound), plus unchanged tiny floor × z.

physicalDemand.formula: D = D20 × [T × (launchSpeed − endpointSpeed)] / [T20 × (launchSpeed20 − endpointSpeed)] + existing redirection + motion

solver.spinConstraint: Joint speed/backspin solve for depth and fast travel time; endpoint takes priority at physical bounds
